# Resources / References / Core Reference

> main documentation section. Applicability within this branch is unknown unless a linked page says otherwise.

## Pages

- [Actions Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/resources/references/core-reference/actions-reference.md): Actions Reference: Shopware developer documentation.
- [Commands Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/resources/references/core-reference/commands-reference.md): Commands Reference: These commands can be executed using the Shopware command line interface \(CLI\), located within your Shopware project.
- [Composer Commands Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/resources/references/core-reference/composer-commands-reference.md): Composer Commands Reference: These commands are only available inside shopware/shopware GitHub repository, so when you contribute to Shopware. For regular projects, use ./bin/.sh scripts.
- [Core Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/resources/references/core-reference.md): Core Reference: The Core reference documents essential components like the DAL, administration panel, flags, filters, Flow Builder, and Rules for efficient platform usage.
